purpose: iOS-specific UX/UI design guide that consolidates Apple HIG guidance for iOS: touch input, navigation, layout, standard components, UX patterns and an evaluation checklist.
summary: Touch input model: target sizes, gestures, reachability
Navigation patterns: tab bar, navigation bar, modal, transitions
Layout: safe area, device screen sizes, spacing standards
Standard iOS components: controls, content display, navigation
iOS UX patterns: pull to refresh, swipe actions, context menu, haptics
Evaluation checklist for touch, navigation, layout and accessibility
tasks: Designing or analyzing iOS app UI
Mapping a design to HIG standard components
Reviewing touch targets and navigation of an iOS design
Evaluating iOS accessibility such as Dynamic Type and VoiceOver
Creating design tokens for an iOS app
title: iOS プラットフォームガイド
